key_insight: LLM agents can infer hidden circuit behavior from pin-level experiments, but fully correct and efficient reconstructions remain rare.
engineering_relevance: ChiProgramBench tests whether AI agents can turn experimental observations into cycle-accurate gate-level replacements while meeting power, delay, and area goals.
method: Probe 18 hidden, stateful circuits through simulated input and output pins.
Compare black-box discovery with function-guided reconstruction that adds circuit purpose and pin roles.
Submit netlists using public library cells; award efficiency credit only after all hidden functional tests pass.
evidence_signal: Across 432 trials of six agent configurations, full-pass rates were 12.0% for black-box and 14.8% for function-guided tasks; only three of 58 fully passing designs improved combined power, area, and delay over the reference.
watch_item: Higher partial functional scores do not establish cycle-accurate correctness or efficient implementation.
paper_title: ChiProgramBench: Can LLM Agents Rebuild Efficient Circuits from Pin-Level Experiments?
